adjudication.rationale: The diff removes the prior incremental membership-update specs that asserted silent behavior on edge cases (e.g., adding a non-existent username and removing a non-member), and the new specs under `context ".add_members"` / `context ".remove_member"` don’t cover those cases. In `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`, unknown usernames are silently skipped via `if user = User.find_by_username(username)` and still return success if `group.save` succeeds, but there is no test pinning that behavior now. Similarly, `#remove_member` uses `group.users.delete(user_id)` and will succeed even if the user isn’t in the group, with no test asserting intended behavior. This is a concrete coverage regression for newly introduced endpoints/flows, not a directly verifiable functional bug from the diff alone.
